safety_policy: DrPrettyman_DS_64x64 is protected and never quarantined by this pass.
Same-source identical files are preserved as possible semantic aliases; only cross-source exact mirrors are deletion candidates.
Official shiny component slots are protected; shiny-vs-normal is not treated as junk recolor.
Recolor detection only flags exact same pixel partition/shape with different palette values.
Official/canonical palette sources, shiny paths, and known official palette-form families are excluded from recolor deletion.
Vanilla base-species coverage accepts a concrete non-Mega form filename when the bare species filename does not exist.
This pass writes deletion candidates only; it does not delete image files.
